alignments.note: Fixed expression `al-ken` rendered by one English word (rule 30); headed on the adverb that carries the lexeme.
No pronominal suffix on `piqqudei`; the ASV supplies `thy`.
Nomen rectum of the construct chain; the ASV recasts `of` as `concerning` and expands the substantive with `things`, so the head stays on `all` (rules 19, 31).

Declarative piel of `yashar` rendered periphrastically `I esteem ... to be right`; subject pronoun and the small clause belong to the verb (rule 17). Heading on `right` follows the lexeme (rule 24); heading on `esteem`, the finite English predicate, is defensible.
Construct chain rendered attributively, `false way` rather than `way of falsehood` (rule 28).
No waw before `sane'ti`; the ASV supplies the connective for the parallel line.
Acrostic stanza heading for Pe, printed by the ASV at the close of the Ayin stanza; no source token licenses it.

review_notes: The acrostic letter heading that the ASV prints at each stanza boundary (here `Pe`, with its Hebrew letter) has no counterpart in the source and is marked `added` as a single unit. This recurs at every eighth verse of PSA.119.
